name: Mars Group Holdings Corporation
summary: Mars Group Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, sale, and provision of peripheral equipment for amusement-related facilities in Japan. It operates through the Amusement-Related Business, Smart Solution-Related Business, and Hotel and Restaurant-Related Business segments. The company also provides automatic recognition systems, such as radio frequency identification (RFID), barcodes, 2D codes, and x-ray inspection systems for the medical care, education, libraries, and factory automation fields; IoT-enabled refrigerated vending machines and unmanned check-in terminals; electronic devices; information processing services; electronic and information …
